services.name: ALL DAY WHALE WATCH (8-12hrs)
services.desc: With all day on the water, we have more time to explore the bay, travel offshore, and get to interesting sightings reports! About All Day whale watching trips run 8-12hrs weather permitting. These special trips are limited to ~65% of our passenger capacity for a more comfortable experience. Unlike our weekly whale watching trips, all day trips are not fully narrated over the PA, but several naturalists are on board to answer questions and direct attention to wildlife. Definitely bring food for yourself or to share! There is also a small snack bar on board with small snack items plus sodas,

services.name: Extended Whale Watch
services.desc: Do you feel like whale watching trips always end too soon? Then our extended trips are for you! The longer time allows us to spend more time with the animals for better photos, and gives us a higher chance of seeing more species. You should be confident in your seaworthiness (either know you don't get seasick or know how to prevent it) so you can enjoy this long trip! About Enjoy the adventure in comfort on our 60ft luxury yacht, High Spirits. Immaculate and spacious, our boat has plenty of room on the bow, inside the cabin with plenty of windows, and on our observation deck with a bird's eye 6-8hr Whale Watching Trip

blurb: Blue Ocean Whale Watching offers whale watching tours in Monterey Bay, focusing on a variety of marine wildlife including humpback whales, gray whales, and dolphins. Tours depart from Moss Landing Harbor, the closest port to the Monterey Submarine Canyon. The company emphasizes knowledgeable crew, reduced capacity for better viewing, and a comfortable boat experience.

faq.q: Do I have to purchase tickets in advance?
faq.a: Advance purchase is strongly recommended, and trips often sell out quickly. To maximize your chances of getting the day and time you prefer, please buy your tickets well in advance. Tickets can be purchased with a Visa, Mastercard or American Express.

quotes.text: We saw much more than we expected. In the 80s we saw no whales and no dolphins either. We saw many gray whales and tons of dolphins of a few varieties. I’m glad I went with this company. We had a variety of places to go–the wheelhouse, up on the upper deck with seating, the bow, with seating, or the rear deck, or you could go below. The boat was really comfortable and the captain and naturalist were really nice. We will use Blue Ocean again this summer–our parents want to go out. Great company.

I’ve been out with Blue Ocean Whale Watch a handful of times, and every one has been a great experience. Kate, their naturalist, is super knowledgable and offers lots of interesting facts throughout the trip. Jim is an awesome captain who gets us close to the action, but keeps a respectful distance from the animals to ensure they don’t get stressed. We saw a dozen humpbacks, a cow and calf pair that approached the boat, and hundreds of common dolphins this trip. I can’t recommend them enough.

The crew and boat were absolutely fantastic. We went on a two hour cruise and they took us directly to a spot with 3-4 whales, along with the hundreds of sea lions that follow the anchovies. We were the only boat there for a good 45 minutes. The whales came so close to us; it was a “National Geographic” experience. Didn’t even need or use the binoculars we brought . The naturalist was informative yet didn’t constantly talk the whole time.

My first official whale watching experience and could not have asked for anything better…weather was perfect, boat was a sweet sturdy 60′ Chris Craft with plenty of space and vantages. Very friendly, experienced and accommodating crew. Saw some Gray whales, lots of otters, jellies, sea lions, kelp forests and various fish. Highly recommend Blue Ocean and definitely plan on doing another venture with them in the future.

I’ve been on many whale watching trips on other boats on Monterey Bay over the years. I liked this one the best by far. The staff were really genuinely nice and knowledgable, without the “we’re so cool attitude” I’ve experienced with other companies. And this boat was the most comfortable. And unlike the companies running out of Monterey, you get to park right in front of the boat. Very easy, especially with kids.

Great trip! Very nice boat. Captain Jim and Kate were terrific as well as the volunteer crew! Guaranteed whale sightings or your next trip is free. Fun trip all around. We only saw dolphins on our trip, no whales, so as advertised, Captain Jim and Kate invited us to come back for another trip at no charge. You won’t find this level of customer service anywhere else! We highly recomend Blue Ocean Whale Watch!
